title: Data and code for: Industrial AI Ecosystems and Innovation Diffusion: Mapping Structural Dominance and Its Societal Implications (2018–2025)
description: SQL queries, derived datasets and analysis code for an article in Technology Analysis & Strategic Management. The data cover simple patent families with at least one G06N CPC code published 2018–2025 in Google Patents Public Data (extraction of 17 November 2026): fractional inter-assignee citation edges, family–assignee–CPC portfolios, US-grant sensitivity tables and a year-stratified sample of 40,000 English abstracts. The code reproduces all tables, figures and reported values of the article.
